err.board_missing: The logic board is missing: nothing to plug into.
err.cannot_pair: This part is factory-paired to the board: only the original works.
err.cell_full: This cell is full (4 screws max).
err.connector_left: A connector is still attached to {name}.
err.flip_first: It's on the other side: flip the phone.
err.ipa_first: Snapped tab: soften the adhesive with isopropyl before prying.
err.long_screw_warning: Stop! This screw is {len} mm, the hole is {hole} mm: you'd pierce the board.
err.no_bath: {name} can't go in the ultrasonic bath.
err.no_pairing_data: This part has no pairing data left to read.
err.no_power: It won't boot: check battery, connector and board.
err.no_screw_in_hand: No screw on the tip: pick one from the mat.
err.read_chip_first: Read the data from the original display with the programmer first.
err.remove_before_adhesive: Take {name} out to apply fresh adhesive.
err.remove_board_first: To solder, take the logic board out onto the mat.
err.screw_in_hand: You already hold a screw: put it on the mat.
err.screw_lost: That screw rolled away… find it with the flashlight.
err.screw_stripped: Stripped screw: you need the extractor.
err.screw_wrong_type: Wrong type: this hole takes a {type} screw.
err.suction_first: Lift with the suction cup first to open a gap.
err.tab_broken: Snapped tab: isopropyl and the card.
err.tabs_left: {name} is still glued: pull the adhesive tabs.
err.adhesive_left: {name} is still glued: cut the adhesive.
err.too_deep: Too deep! Flex cables run under there.
err.toothpick_port_only: The toothpick is for the charge port.
err.transfer_first: Transfer {name} from the old part first.
err.adhesive_cold: The adhesive is still cold: heat the edges more.
err.no_pairing_part: This part has nothing to program.
err.not_stripped: This screw isn't stripped: use the driver.
err.suction_cover_only: Use the suction cup on the closed display or back glass.

hint.power_off: Power the phone off (P key): never work on a live device.
hint.power_on: Power the phone back on (P key).
hint.unscrew: Unscrew with the {bit} bit: hold on the screw ({name}).
hint.extract: Stripped screw: hold with the extractor.
hint.place_screw: Put the screw on the magnetic mat, cell {cell}: lengths won't get mixed up.
hint.place_screw_bench: Mat full: put the screw on the bench (it may roll away).
hint.pick_screw: Pick the {len} mm screw from the mat.
hint.screw_in: Drive it in ({bit}, {len} mm): hold and release in the green zone.
hint.find_screw: A screw is missing: look for it with the flashlight.
hint.heat: Heat the edges of {name} to about {temp} °C so the adhesive softens.
hint.suction: Suction cup on {name}: press and pull up to open a gap.
hint.cut: Drag the pick along the edge of {name}: orange = still glued, green = cut. On red, stay close to the edge.
hint.open: Select the Hand (key 1) and click {name} to swing it open like a book.
hint.close: With the Hand: right click {name} to close it (or click, when everything is plugged in).
hint.disconnect_battery: Unplug the battery first with the spudger: nothing stays live.
hint.disconnect: Pop the {name} connector off with the spudger.
hint.connect: Plug the {name} connector back: press until it clicks.
hint.connect_battery: Now the battery: always connected last.
hint.install: With the Hand or tweezers: click {name} on the mat to put it back.
hint.pull_tab: Pull tab {n} with the tweezers: slow and steady, or it snaps.
hint.pry: Pry gently under {name}: never bend or puncture the battery.
hint.pry_pad: Free {name} from its adhesive pad with the spudger.
hint.clean_port: Clean {name} with the toothpick: lint and sand block charging.
hint.clean_ipa: Remove the corrosion on {name} with isopropyl.
hint.replace: Swap {name} for a spare (click the removed part).
hint.read_chip: Read the True Tone data from the original {name} with the programmer.
hint.apply_adhesive: Apply fresh adhesive to {name}: the seal is back.
hint.solder: Take the board under the microscope and solder.
hint.too_long: Screw too long for this hole.
hint.done: All back together! Run the final test.

event.battery_punctured: You punctured the battery! Smoke and stink: it's scrap.
event.board_short: Short on the board: charging is damaged.
event.chip_read: Data read and saved in the programmer.
event.connector_damaged: You damaged a connector while prying.
event.flex_cut: You sliced a flex cable of {name}!
event.long_screw: Long screw in a short hole: you pierced the board!
event.overheat: Too hot! You're cooking the phone.
event.screw_loose: Loose screw: tighten a bit more.
event.screw_lost: A screw rolled off the bench!
event.short_live: Spark! Battery was connected: {name} is fried.
event.short_powered: Spark! The phone was powered on.
event.stripped_slip: The bit slips on the stripped screw: try again, or use the extractor.
event.heat_ready: Adhesive softened! Now take the suction cup and lift the screen.
event.heat_ready_pad: Adhesive softened: now pry with the spudger.
event.screw_on_bench: Screw left on the bench (yellow ring): it may roll away. Pick it up with the driver and put it on the magnetic mat.

issue.no_seal: No fresh seal: not water resistant

tip.replace_me: To replace: click to pick a spare

ammeter.no_current: 0.00 A — draws nothing: dirty or broken port?
ammeter.trickle: A few mA — charging won't start: board fault?
ammeter.unstable: Unstable draw — smells like corrosion or a short.
ammeter.boot_no_screen: It boots but the screen stays black.

inspect.port_dirty: Charge port packed with lint and sand
inspect.water_indicator: Liquid indicator is red: it's been in water
inspect.previous_repair: Marked screws: someone opened it before
